description: Ask the customer support assistant about THIS service: plans and prices, signing up, upgrading or cancelling, invoices, service API keys (rotation, lost key), rate limits, connecting over MCP or REST, data accuracy, and how to reach the owner. Answers come only from the published FAQ, the plan catalogue and the caller's own account; anything the assistant cannot do (refunds, credits, disputes, lost key without the current key, 'talk to a human', security reports) is escalated to the owner with a reference. Identity-aware: with your service key on the MCP connection (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer) it can describe your own plan, payment status, rate limit and key preview; without a key it answers in general. It never reveals keys or other customers' data, never changes billing, and is capped per caller per day (a cap hit returns a non-LLM fallback with FAQ links). The local STDIO server refuses with support_requires_hosted_mcp.
